subject: Pricing & billing structure for Nova AI usage (commit tiers + invoice breakdown)
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@novaai.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-05-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick pricing ask — projected 200M tokens / month

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the demo last week — Nova AI is excited about Redwood's latency profile. We're starting to scope spend for a possible production launch and I need a clear per-token pricing cadence and a few examples for our finance team. Rough numbers: 150–250M tokens/month initially, mostly user-generated prompts + model outputs (mix of chat completions + embeddings for metadata).

Can you send: 1) the per-token price tiers for Hosted API (what discounts kick in at what commit size), 2) an example invoice with line items (commit fee, overage, embedding vs generation token split), and 3) the export format for usage (CSV or JSON) so our billing team can ingest it? Also any minimum term requirements for the discount.

If you can get something to me by end of week that would be great — our procurement is asking for a realistic monthly estimate to present to leadership.

Best,
Elena
Director of Platform & Partnerships
Nova AI

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.inference.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@novaai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-05-11T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick pricing ask — projected 200M tokens / month

Hi Elena — great to hear from you and glad the demo resonated. Attached is a short proposal that outlines two commit structures we typically recommend for usage at your scale plus a sample invoice. Highlights below:

- Option A (12-month commit): 120M monthly commit @ $0.0009 / token with stepped discounts at 250M and 500M usage; includes monthly usage CSV and token-level breakdown.
- Option B (month-to-month with volume tiers): no base commit, volume discounts applied at end-of-month (starts at 5% at 100M, up to 18% >500M).

Invoice line items provided: base commit fee (if selected), overage per-token, embedding token unit (separately metered), support add-ons, and any one-time onboarding credits. The sample attachment (Redwood_PROPOSAL_NOVA_20260515.pdf) includes exact numbers and an example invoice layout.

We can export usage as a CSV (columns: date, route, model, input_tokens, output_tokens, total_tokens, request_id) — happy to add or rename columns to match your ingestion. If you prefer a secured S3/CSV drop for your billing team, we can set that up.

I've cc'd Ben from commercial who can confirm discount approval flow. If you can share a 6–12 month volume forecast, I can produce a firm quote for the commit option.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
(signed)

Attachment: Redwood_PROPOSAL_NOVA_20260515.pdf

From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@novaai.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: Tom Harris <tharris@novaai.com>, procurement@novaai.com
Date: 2026-05-14T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick pricing ask — projected 200M tokens / month

Thanks, Soojin — proposal looks helpful. A few follow-ups before we escalate to finance:

1) For the 12-month commit, is the commit fee billed monthly or upfront? Can you provide an amortization example on the invoice?
2) We need a token breakdown on the invoice: input vs output tokens and embeddings separately (embeddings will be roughly 20M tokens/month).
3) What happens if usage spikes beyond the top tier (e.g., sudden viral growth) — do you have a mechanism for temporary overage credit or burst capacity pricing?
4) Our finance team requires a machine-readable monthly usage export. Can you confirm the CSV header names and sample of a single month's output?

Finally — any constraints on billing region and VAT? We're US-based but have EMEA customers routed from our EU instance.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.
Elena

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.inference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-05-15T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Nova AI — pricing and invoice format questions

Ben/Laura — forwarding Nova's ask below. Key asks: commit amortization on invoice, token-level line items including embeddings, a machine-readable monthly export, and clear burst/overage policy.

My suggested approach:
- Approve a 12-month commit billed monthly (invoice shows monthly amortized commit line + effective per-token rate).
- Provide a separate embedding token unit priced at 60% of generation token rate.
- Add a temporary burst buffer (1.5x monthly commit) that can be used with an overage multiplier (1.25x) before we apply on-demand pricing. For sustained growth we propose a fast re-quote.
- Provide usage CSV sample and add columns: iso_date, route, model, input_tokens, output_tokens, embed_tokens, total_tokens, request_id, marketplace_flag.

Attached: SaaS_Order_Form_NOVA_20260515.docx (order + billing terms). Can you confirm if legal needs a special clause for amortized commit billing and whether finance can supply the usage_report_sample.csv template? Once we have sign-off I will send the consolidated quote and DocuSign link.

Thanks — Soojin

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-05-17T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Nova AI — pricing and invoice format questions

Soojin — agree with your recommended approach with minor edits for finance/legal hygiene. Proposed concrete invoice layout and policies below: 

Invoice line items (monthly):
- Monthly Commit Amortization: $108,000 (represents 120M token commit amortized monthly)
- Monthly Usage Overages: per-token rate $0.0011 applied to tokens above commit after burst buffer
- Embedding Tokens: listed separately (unit price $0.00066 per token)
- Temporary Burst Buffer: 1.5x commit (no upfront charge) with a 1.25x per-token overage multiplier during buffer consumption
- Credits / One-time: onboarding credit line if negotiated

Billing/export: finance can provide usage_report_sample.csv (we'll attach a template). CSV must include iso_date, route, model, input_tokens, output_tokens, embed_tokens, total_tokens, request_id, invoice_period. We'll also provide a daily S3 export if Nova prefers.

Legal: standard amortized commit clause is fine, but require a 30-day notice for contract cancellations and a clause that allows us to re-quote if sustained usage exceeds 200% of commit for more than two consecutive months.

I attached the usage_report_sample.csv template for your ops team. If accepted, we can generate a final order form and DocuSign link by EOD Monday.

-Ben
Head of Commercial
Redwood Inference

Attachment: usage_report_sample.csv

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.inference.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@novaai.com>, Tom Harris <tharris@novaai.com>, procurement@novaai.com
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.inference.com>
Date: 2026-05-18T15:40:00-07:00
Subject: Finalized quote and next steps — Nova AI (DocuSign link)

Elena / Tom / Procurement team — thanks for the patience while we finalized internal approvals. Below is the consolidated proposal we recommend and the next steps: 

Final pricing (hosted API, US region) — 12-month commit (monthly amortized billing):
- Commit: 120M tokens/month — amortized monthly commit fee: $108,000 (equivalent to $0.0009/token)
- Embedding tokens: $0.00066/token (listed as separate invoice line item)
- Burst buffer: 1.5x monthly commit available; overage during buffer billed at 1.25x per-token rate ($0.001125/token)
- Sustained >200% of commit for 2 months triggers re-quote/capacity planning (no immediate termination)

Invoice & export: monthly invoice will include the amortized commit line, usage overages, embedding line, and any credits. We will attach a CSV (usage_report_sample.csv) in the billing portal every month; CSV headers will match the template we shared. We can also provide a daily S3 export if you need near-real-time ingestion. VAT will be applied according to billing address; for multi-region accounts we can separate EU invoicing if required.

Attachments: Redwood_PROPOSAL_NOVA_20260515.pdf, SaaS_Order_Form_NOVA_20260515.docx, usage_report_sample.csv

Next steps: 
1) I will push a DocuSign packet with the order form and amortization clause (link: https://www.docusign.net/prepare/NOVA-5Y8K2).
2) Procurement to confirm billing address for VAT handling.
3) Ops to ingest our usage_report_sample.csv and confirm field mapping.

If this works, I'll send the DocuSign envelope now and we can target May 25th activation.

Thanks — looking forward to getting Nova onto Redwood.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.inference.com
